name: Asuka♂ Josou Bishounen Ryoujoku Story 2
original_name: あすか♂女装美少年凌辱ストーリー２
source:
A beautiful boy had been spending the days out in a school where girls dominate boys. One day, a girl came to the school. How affable transfer studnet, Urasawa Hina changed the life of the boy? The boy begun to like her as things went on. But she had a secret she hadn't said to anybody.....

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE015271.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个漂亮的男孩在一所女孩占主导地位的学校里度过了几天。有一天，一位女孩来到学校。和蔼可亲的转校生浦泽希奈如何改变了男孩的生活？随着事情的发展，男孩开始喜欢她。但她有一个秘密，没有告诉任何人……

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE015271.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
